subject: math
verificationNotes: Hand-authored; numeric answers checked with sympy.

items.prompt:
An SRS gives every same-size group:
A) a different chance
B) an equal chance
C) no chance
D) a chance based on size

steps: Defining property of SRS. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Sampling every 10th person is:
A) stratified
B) cluster
C) systematic
D) convenience

Randomly sampling within each grade level is:
A) cluster
B) stratified
C) systematic
D) SRS

steps: Groups then random within. Key is B.

items.prompt:
An online poll of only self-selected responders has:
A) no bias
B) voluntary response bias
C) stratification
D) undercoverage only

steps: Strong opinions overrepresented. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Surveying whole randomly chosen classrooms is:
A) cluster
B) stratified
C) systematic
D) convenience

Increasing sample size reduces:
A) bias
B) variability
C) the population
D) the mean

steps: Size cuts variance, not bias. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Selected people who refuse to answer create:
A) nonresponse bias
B) stratification
C) lower variance
D) a census

steps: Non-answerers may differ. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Bias is best described as:
A) random error
B) systematic error in one direction
C) small sample size
D) a wide interval
items.answer: B) systematic error in one direction

solution.answer: B) systematic error in one direction
